findings.body: The required Done-when is not met. `statesAmountComparison` treats any non-date digit as an amount, so identifier-only questions such as “Actual for GL 50001201” or “statement line 9.01” retain a selector-invented `Actual > 0` filter and can still drop zero lines. The selector prompt at `backend/src/llm/llm.constants.ts:56` was not updated with the required explicit prohibition against adding unstated comparisons. Finally, the added tests use fake selector/executor fixtures; there is no real-entry-point proof or recorded 4-of-4 live result showing all 81 DUB/CHIR lines. Required title: `Not done: an amount comparison is kept only when the question states an amount or comparison, the selector prompt says never to add one, and the DUB and CHIR each-line statement lists all 81 lines in 4 of 4 live runs; leaves for kept and dropped forms`.
